source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 16. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: Du'aa is the marrow of worship; a du'aa for every moment

learn.en: Dhikr means remembering Allah. Du'aa means asking Allah humbly for something — and it is an act of worship, made to Allah only.
learn.title: Dhikr and du'aa

learn.en: Du'aa is the “marrow” of worship — its most important part. Allah says: “Invoke Me and I will answer you.”
learn.title: The marrow of worship

learn.en: Every gift is from Allah: our eyes, ears, tongues, hands and legs. We thank Him by remembering Him.
learn.title: Every gift is from Him
learn.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Subḥāna-llāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, wa lā ilāha illa-llāh, wallāhu akbar

learn.en: When getting into a car or any transport, say the travel du'aa.
learn.title: In the car
learn.ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
learn.tr: Subḥāna lladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahū muqrinīn, wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn

learn.en: We learnt du'aas for waking, sleeping, the toilet, leaving home, the masjid and sneezing. Keep saying them at every moment!
learn.title: A du'aa for every moment

learn.en: “Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.” (Qur'an 13:28)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

words.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ
words.en: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest
words.tr: Subḥāna-llāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, wa lā ilāha illa-llāh, wallāhu akbar

words.ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
words.en: Riding: Glory be to Him who made this serve us… and to our Lord we will return

words.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
words.en: Leaving home: In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah
words.tr: Bismi-llāh, tawakkaltu ʿala-llāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh

words.en: Going to bed: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live
Reply to a sneeze: May Allah have mercy on you

quiz.en: Who should Muslims make du'aa to?
Allah says: “Invoke Me and I will ___ you.”
True or false? We may make du'aa in our own words too.

think.q: Can you name 11 moments in the day when there is a du'aa to say?
think.a: Waking, toilet in/out, leaving home, car, masjid in/out, sneezing, eating, after eating, sleeping…

parents.summary: Dhikr (remembrance) and du'aa (asking Allah, the marrow of worship); the four phrases of dhikr and du'aas for the car, leaving home, sleep and sneezing.
parents.tip: Say the car du'aa together every time you drive.
